title: Free AI Text Detector – Check if Text Was Written by AI
excerpt: Paste any text and see how likely it was written by AI, with AI-generated passages highlighted. Free, instant and private.
content_html:
Paste any essay, article, post or story. You'll get an AI score and see which passages read as AI-generated.

0 words

Frequently asked questions

How does the AI text detector work?

Paste your text and press Analyze. Every sentence is scored, AI-like passages are highlighted, and you get an overall AI percentage with a confidence level.

Is my text stored or sent anywhere?

No. The analysis runs entirely in your browser. Your text is never uploaded or saved.

How much text do I need?

At least 50 words. Longer texts give more reliable results.

Is the result 100% accurate?

No AI detector is perfect. Treat the score as an indication, not proof, and never use it as the only basis for an important decision.
